recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century studio portrait of a male musician in a dark suit, centrally positioned and surrounded by multiple stringed instruments, framed by bold, multi-colored slab-serif typography and a list of tracks on a neutral, slightly warm-toned background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a vertical guitar neck
Symmetrical instrument arrangement at the base
High-contrast blue and orange-red typography flanking the subject
Neutral studio backdrop providing depth for the dark suit
coreInvariants: Muted, slightly desaturated color film aesthetic
Heavy slab-serif display type with drop shadows
Clean, centered studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length central portrait, head at the upper third, feet obscured by instruments.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical acoustic guitar in the center foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large numeric value top-left, moves to the artist name on the right, then down to the instrument cluster.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room in the upper corners and around the subject's torso.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy or black of the suit.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan-blue for the artist name and orange-red for the numeric highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photograph contrasted with high-value, saturated primary-adjacent colors in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muted earth tones for the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and wide grotesque sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky serifs with minimal stroke contrast.
Secondary text uses wide, all-caps sans-serif with generous tracking.
Numeric characters feature a 3D drop-shadow effect.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Dollar signs and numbers are stylized with thick outlines and offset shadows.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold slab serif for names paired with wide, spaced-out sans-serif for descriptions.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif weight and blunt terminals.
For the wide, small-serif secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio portrait of a 1950s male musician in a dark suit, standing behind a collection of vintage guitars and a banjo. The background is a plain, warm-grey studio wall. Soft, even lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large cyan slab-serif text on the right. Add large orange-red slab-serif text with black drop shadows on the top left. Include a list of song titles in small, wide all-caps sans-serif on the left side.

verificationChecks: Is the typography bold and slab-serif?
Are the instruments arranged at the subject's feet?
Is the color palette muted with bright cyan and orange accents?

adjustableVariables: Specific accent colors (e.g., swapping cyan for yellow)

mustAchieve: Authentic 1960s film grain and color balance

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text has a physical 'printed' look with slight ink bleed.
Check that the drop shadows on the text are consistent in direction.
Verify the subject's pose is formal and centered.
Confirm the instruments look like period-accurate vintage models.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered 1950s studio portrait with heavy slab-serif display type in primary-adjacent colors, using a neutral beige background and a list-based layout for secondary information.
